capabilities: Preview unsupported image formats in a dedicated view
Embed images via markdown inline links and HTML img tags
Export images to png, jpg, and webp with resize options
Auto-export converted images when the source file changes
disambiguation: Not an image editor; it only previews, embeds, and converts image formats.
extras: README lists default-supported and known-broken formats (e.g. TGA, SVG) and notes link suggestions require enabling 'Detect all file extensions' or a plugin such as Boost Link Suggestions.
problem: Obsidian only previews a set of built-in image formats, so files like Photoshop PSD or HEIC cannot be viewed or embedded in notes without a third-party app.
summary: Image format viewer and converter that previews and embeds formats Obsidian does not support natively, such as PSD, HEIC, and TIFF, using ImageMagick.
